answer: Every identity must age 10 epochs and earn reputation from 10 peer-verified jobs before rewards, with 100 POA bonded throughout. Each epoch a random audit rechecks 20 percent of identities; failure slashes half the bond and resets reputation to zero. A fake fleet cannot shortcut aging: each extra identity needs its own 10-epoch wait, its own 10 jobs, and its own bond, recorded on an onyx ledger. Audits use a raven-black random seed, and a violet flag marks reused work, so verifiers reject the cluster before paying, and marginal cost rises in time, stake, and reputation per extra identity.
